script_compliance.greeting_script: Thank you for calling Example Company, my name is [Agent Name]. How may I assist you today?
script_compliance.closing_script: Is there anything else I can help you with today? Thank you for choosing Example Company and have a wonderful day!
script_compliance.required_verification_steps:
1. Ask for the customer's full name
2. Ask for their account number or registered phone number
3. Verify with the last 4 digits of their payment method on file
script_compliance.hold_procedure: Before hold: 'May I place you on a brief hold while I look into this for you?' After hold: 'Thank you so much for holding, I appreciate your patience.'
script_compliance.transfer_procedure: Agent must explain why the transfer is needed, provide the department name, and ask for permission before transferring. Example: 'I'd like to connect you with our billing department who can better assist you with this. Would that be okay?'
script_compliance.escalation_procedure: Escalate to supervisor if: (1) customer explicitly requests a supervisor, (2) customer threatens legal action or regulatory complaint, (3) issue cannot be resolved after 2 genuine attempts, (4) customer has been on the call for more than 15 minutes without resolution.
script_compliance.mandatory_disclosures:
1. At the start of every call: 'This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.'
2. Before processing any payment: 'I want to confirm the amount of [amount] will be charged to your [payment method]. Do I have your authorization to proceed?'
3. For warranty claims: 'Please note that our warranty does not cover damage from misuse or unauthorized modifications.'
script_compliance.prohibited_phrases:
1. 'That's not my department' - instead say 'Let me connect you with the right team'
2. 'I don't know' - instead say 'That's a great question, let me look into that for you'
3. 'You should have...' - never blame the customer
4. 'Calm down' - never tell a customer to calm down
5. 'There's nothing I can do' - instead say 'Here's what I can do for you'
6. 'No problem' - instead say 'You're welcome' or 'My pleasure'

factual_accuracy.policies:
Return/Refund Policy: Full refund within 30 days of purchase for annual plans. Monthly plans can be cancelled anytime, no refund for current billing period.
Data Retention: Customer data retained for 90 days after account closure, then permanently deleted.
Account Sharing: Each user must have their own login. Sharing credentials is a violation of ToS.
Downtime Credits: If uptime falls below SLA, customers receive prorated credit for the affected period.
factual_accuracy.common_troubleshooting:
Issue: Cannot log in
Steps: 1. Verify correct email address 2. Use 'Forgot Password' link 3. Check spam folder for reset email 4. Clear browser cache and cookies 5. Try incognito/private mode 6. If still failing, escalate to Tier 2

Issue: Slow upload speeds
Steps: 1. Check internet connection speed at speedtest.net 2. Try a different browser 3. Disable VPN if active 4. Clear browser cache 5. Try the desktop app instead of web

Issue: Storage full notification
Steps: 1. Check current usage in Settings > Storage 2. Delete unnecessary files or empty trash 3. Suggest upgrade to next plan tier or Extra Storage Pack

factual_accuracy.frequently_asked_questions:
Q: How do I upgrade my plan? A: Go to Settings > Billing > Change Plan, or call us and we can do it for you.
Q: Can I transfer my data to another account? A: Yes, go to Settings > Data > Transfer. Both accounts must be active.
Q: Is my data encrypted? A: Yes, we use AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.
Q: What payment methods do you accept? A: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and bank transfer for Enterprise plans.

behavioral.tone_guidelines: Always use the customer's name at least twice during the call. Maintain a warm, professional tone throughout. Avoid technical jargon unless the customer uses it first. Match the customer's energy level - if they're in a hurry, be efficient; if they want to chat, be personable. Always thank the customer for their patience when there are delays.
behavioral.empathy_guidelines: When a customer expresses frustration, ALWAYS acknowledge their feeling before offering a solution. Use phrases like 'I completely understand how frustrating this must be' or 'I can see why that would be upsetting.' Never minimize their experience. If the issue was caused by our error, apologize sincerely: 'I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this has caused you.'
behavioral.conflict_resolution_guidelines: Stay calm and professional at all times. Do not argue or become defensive. Listen actively and let the customer finish speaking. Acknowledge their concerns. Offer concrete solutions or alternatives. If the customer becomes verbally abusive, give one warning: 'I want to help you, but I need us to communicate respectfully.' If behavior continues, offer to have a supervisor call them back. Never hang up on a customer.
behavioral.resolution_expectations: An issue is considered resolved when the customer confirms they are satisfied with the outcome. If the issue cannot be resolved on the first call, create a support ticket, provide the ticket number to the customer, and set clear expectations for follow-up timeline. Always offer to call the customer back if the resolution requires research time.
